design_brief.problem_statement: Godot a13da4feb create_server passes p_max_channels + SYSCH_MAX as ENetConnection incoming bandwidth, ignoring the requested zero default. After bandwidth accounting starts, the client throttle limit becomes1/32 and its first unreliable INPUT can be discarded despite put_packet returning OK.
design_brief.current_behavior: Canonical EnetMultiPeerTransportPort requests six channels and inherits the wrong tiny incoming bandwidth. Archived EG1 failures show three reliable operations and no movement. Native exact-engine A/B reproduces successful enqueue with lost INPUT; disabling RTT deceleration does not fix it.
design_brief.desired_behavior: The production listener explicitly restores host.bandwidth_limit(0,0) after successful create_server and before publishing readiness. Keep default adaptive RTT throttling and raw unreliable/application-sequenced delivery.
alternatives_considered: Explicitly restore documented bandwidth defaults in the existing adapter
Reject disabling adaptive throttling in fixtures: controlled A/B did not fix the bandwidth limit
Reject retransmission/duplicate-ledger changes and increased timeouts
Do not replace the pinned Godot binary or change channel count
design_brief.selected_design: One owning listener-initialization correction plus an additive real-ENet bandwidth-lifetime regression invoked by the existing EG1 test. Unmodified EG1 three-process scenario remains the end-to-end acceptance.
design_brief.why_selected: Corrects the demonstrated producer of the wrong network precondition rather than masking its consumer timeout; all protocol and gameplay behavior stays unchanged.
expected_risks: Shared adapter affects other network consumers
